column1: # Per runtime module: the billions of user-space instructions `nts hir
# --prepared <module>` retires -- the compiler process itself, not the
# frontend it starts -- and, for the reader only, its CPU seconds then. Read
# by tooling/gate/compile-time.mjs, which fails a module at 2x its count and
# 20 G more. Rewrite with `node tooling/gate/compile-time.mjs --record` on a
# binary you have checked is not slower, and say why in the commit.
